claims.claim: The proposal requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, for 12 months of Technical Steering Committee support.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
WP2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group to support protocol governance and evolution.
WP3 will establish a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
The proposal states that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states that execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold and may include deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

Intersect will use the Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard for auditing funds on chain.

summary: The document describes a 1,193,000 ADA treasury withdrawal for 12 months of TSC support, broken into three work packages, with on-chain smart-contract administration, references for budget-process verification, and stated audit, reporting, and unspent-funds-return commitments.
